name: 89142 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89142 (Las Vegas) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89142 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89142 (Las Vegas) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
